before: A press or text selection in widget controls inside the pages armed a document selection gesture. The selection mirror then collapsed the document range and moved focus back to the pages.
after: Host UI marked with data-docx-host-ui keeps its own focus and selection. The private React host marks widget controls and reads the native selection through nested and continued block fragments.
reason: The change only decides which local DOM selection the editor adopts. It writes no document content, identities, awareness fields, or transport data. Remote selections still come from native model positions.
